text_block_list.text:
"Team 'DREAMS,' aiming for total victory 
at the BC. As comrades who will challenge 
this dream together, everyone introduced 
themselves once again!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Even if my opponent is the whole 
world, I'm gonna show 'em that I'm the 
strongest! Listen up, get fired up, you 
guys!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Becoming teammates with all of you must 
surely be divine guidance... Fufu, let us 
strive together to overcome our trials.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"All right, I'll give it my all! For 
Love-chan, and for everyone else too! I'll 
support you with everything I've got!"
